instruction: The lower-L2 RMSprop mean validation R2 around 0.6222 is fine. As long as R2 increases by a measurable amount.
supersedes: The assistant-proposed +0.01 mean validation R2 threshold in the original plan.
criterion: Positive mean validation R2 gain under matched confirmation budgets, with improvement in at least two paired seeds.
configuration_selection_unchanged: Lowest three-seed mean validation MSE; best validation checkpoint within selected configuration.
